inizio.sotto: Sensitive data is replaced before it leaves this PC and put back in the answers.
inizio.tessera.testo.sotto: Paste the text: it is masked and copied for you, ready for the AI. Do the same with the answer and the real values come back.
inizio.tessera.documenti.sotto: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF and whole folders: you give the AI the anonymised copy.
inizio.tessera.guida.sotto: With the keyboard in any program, or automatically in the browser.
inizio.canale.terminale: Claude Code, Codex and other command-line tools
inizio.canale.proxy: For programs that go through a proxy

aggiornamenti.pronto.sotto: The program closes and reopens by itself in a few seconds.
aggiornamenti.installazione_avviata: Installation started: the program will reopen by itself.
aggiornamenti.nota.installer: Once a day the program reads a public file from the releases page: it sends nothing. An update is accepted only if it carries the author's signature, and it is installed the next time the program starts.
aggiornamenti.nota.store: This copy comes from the Microsoft Store: the Store installs the updates.
aggiornamenti.nota.sorgenti: Running from source: the program tells you when a new version is out, but does not update itself. The check reads a public file and sends nothing.
testo.sotto: To use AI inside any program. Paste here: ordinary text is masked, an answer containing placeholders is turned back into the real values. The result goes to the clipboard by itself. In any program, <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>M</kbd> (mask the clipboard) and <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>R</kbd> (restore it) do the same.
testo.ingresso: Your text, or the AI's answer
testo.ingresso.sotto: Pasting starts it automatically. If you type, choose Mask or Restore yourself.
testo.esempio: Example: Good morning, I am Giulia Ferraresi from Nevatek S.r.l., my number is 347 5551234…
testo.incolla.negato: The browser does not allow reading the clipboard: paste into the box with Ctrl+V.
testo.mascherato.copiato: Masked text copied: now paste it into the AI.
testo.mascherato.fatto: Text masked: copy it and paste it into the AI.
testo.ripristinato.copiato: Real values put back: the text is on the clipboard.
testo.ripristinati: {n} placeholders turned back into real values.
documenti.sotto: For attachments and working folders: you give the AI the anonymised copy, then turn the files it produces back into the real values. Formats: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text, PDF and images. PDFs, scans and photos come out as a text file: text from scans is read automatically and may contain errors, so read it through.
documenti.trascina: Drop files here. In automatic mode a file containing placeholders is restored, the others are anonymised.
documenti.troppo_grande: File larger than 40 MB: use the folder option.
documenti.cartella.sotto: Creates, next to the original, a copy with the same content anonymised (name.anon) or restored (name.ripristinato). Unsupported files are skipped, not copied.
guida.sotto: Omissis replaces personal data with labels such as [PERSONA_1] before a text reaches an AI service, and puts the real values back in the answer. Everything happens on this computer.
guida.testo.1: Copy what you want to give the AI, open Text and press Paste from the clipboard: the masked text is already on the clipboard.
guida.testo.3: Copy the AI's answer and press Paste from the clipboard again: Omissis recognises the placeholders and gives you the text with the real values.
guida.tastiera: 2 · With the keyboard, in any program
guida.tastiera.1: Select the text and copy it (<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>C</kbd>).
guida.tastiera.2: Press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>M</kbd>: the clipboard now holds the masked version. Paste it into the AI (<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>V</kbd>).
guida.tastiera.3: Copy the answer and press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>R</kbd>: the real values are back on the clipboard.
guida.tastiera.nota: The same two actions are in the menu of the Omissis icon, next to the clock (if you cannot see it, it is under the small ^ arrow).
guida.documenti.1: Open Documents and drop the files: the anonymised copy for the AI is downloaded by itself.
guida.documenti.2: For a whole folder, type its path: a name.anon copy is created next to it.
guida.documenti.3: Drop the files the AI produces in the same way: Omissis recognises the placeholders and puts the real values back.
guida.automatico.testo: With the Omissis extension for Chrome and Edge you do nothing: write on Claude or ChatGPT as usual, and for a moment "data replaced before sending" appears at the bottom right. The same goes for connected desktop apps and command-line tools. Connections are set up once, by whoever manages the computer, from advanced mode.
guida.sapere.1: It is not infallible. A program can miss a piece of data: always read the masked text before sending it, especially if it is sensitive.
guida.sapere.2: Labels are stable. The same person always gets the same label, so a conversation resumed days later can still be restored.
guida.sapere.3: If a red "message not sent" warning appears, protection is off: turn it back on from the Home page or from the icon.
guida.sapere.4: Images and photos of documents are not protected in messages: do not attach them.
impostazioni.sotto: Language, appearance and updates. In advanced mode, also how data is recognised.
impostazioni.avanzata.sotto: Shows the sections for whoever manages the computer: connections, service rules, activity, vault.
impostazioni.da_riavviare: Restart protection from the Home page to apply it.
riconoscimento.modello.sotto: Changing it requires restarting protection. If the model is not on this PC it is downloaded.
riconoscimento.casella.sotto: On Enter, data is replaced right in the message box, before the site or app reads it. It is the defence that best survives changes to the services: leave it on.
riconoscimento.ripristina: Put real values back in answers
riconoscimento.ripristina.sotto: When off, answers keep the placeholders: useful to see what the service receives.
riconoscimento.blocca_file.sotto: Files attached to messages (PDFs, images) are not masked: blocking them is the cautious choice.
liste.sempre.sotto: Names of confidential projects, internal codes, terms the model cannot know.
liste.mai.sotto: Added to the well-known names already built in (vendors, products): for example your own company name.
liste.nota: One term per line. Upper and lower case do not matter.
liste.salvate: Lists saved: {sempre} terms to always mask, {mai} never to mask.
collegamenti.sotto: The routes through which protection works by itself. Turn on only the ones you need: they all share the same rules (AI services) and the same vault.
browser.collegamento.sotto: It replaces data before the page sends it and puts it back in the answer, with no proxy and no certificate. It only works together with this program and must be connected once per browser. Until it is connected, or while protection is off, messages to protected services are not sent.
browser.stato.senza_risposta: connected, but protection is not responding
browser.collegata_senza_risposta: Extension connected, but protection is not responding: start it from the Home page.
browser.codice_non_pronto: The code is created the first time protection starts: start it from the Home page.
browser.installazione.1: In the browser open chrome://extensions (in Edge edge://extensions) and turn on Developer mode.
browser.installazione.2: Press Load unpacked and choose this folder:
browser.installazione.3: Open this panel in that browser and press Connect this browser.
browser.installazione.4: Try it with made-up data: in Activity, the extension's rows are marked "extension".
browser.a_mano.sotto: If the panel is open in a different browser from the one with the extension: copy the code and paste it into the extension's small window (the Omissis icon next to the address bar). The code lets its holder use this PC's protection: do not share it.
app.stato.attesa: connected, but NOT verified yet: send a test message with made-up data
app.stato.no: connected, but NOT protected: messages go out in clear
app.numeri: {pagine} windows followed · {messaggi} messages with replacements · {controllati} checked with nothing to replace · {sostituzioni} values replaced · {bloccate} requests blocked
app.sapere.1: Experimental. Claude and ChatGPT for Windows are, underneath, a browser showing the service's site: started from here they get the same protection as the extension, with no certificate and no proxy.
app.sapere.2: The app must be fully closed (including from the icon next to the clock) before you press "Start protected". Conversations are kept; work in progress in the app is interrupted.
app.sapere.3: While the app is open this way, other programs on this PC can control it through the connection port.
app.sapere.4: If Omissis detaches or is closed, messages to protected services stay blocked in the app until you restart it normally.
app.sapere.5: Verified live only on the ChatGPT app, with made-up data. The conversation saved by the service keeps the placeholders: real values are visible only where Omissis is running.
terminale.fermo: off: it starts together with protection
terminale.numeri: {richieste} requests · {messaggi} with replacements · {sostituzioni} values replaced · {bloccate} stopped
terminale.come.sotto: Instead of the real service you point the tool at the Omissis address, which replaces the data, forwards the request and puts the real values back in the answer, including inside the commands and files the tool writes. The lines apply to the PowerShell window you type them in. Credentials pass through unchanged and are never written anywhere.
terminale.riga.openai: Codex and tools using an OpenAI key
terminale.riga.altri: Other compatible services (base address to put in the tool's configuration)
terminale.verificato.1: Claude Code: tested live with a subscription sign-in and one message of made-up data. Not yet with a real working session made of many commands and files.
terminale.verificato.2: OpenAI format (Codex with a key, opencode, aider and compatible services): tested only against a mock service.
terminale.verificato.3: In the technical context these tools send with every request, only personal data is replaced; the rest (text you write, file contents, command output) is processed in full and may end up masked more than necessary.
terminale.verificato.4: Ollama and LM Studio run on this PC: the data does not leave it. Routing them through here only makes sense if the model is on another computer.
proxy.porta.sotto: The proxy listens only on this PC and decrypts only the traffic of the services you chose to protect. After changing it, restart protection.
proxy.certificato.sotto: A program accepts the proxy only if Windows trusts its certificate. It is installed for the current user only, and Windows asks for confirmation. While it is installed, whoever holds the private key in the data folder can read this user's HTTPS traffic.
proxy.certificato.non_creato: not created yet: start protection once
proxy.finestra.sotto: Opens a separate Chrome or Edge window that goes through the proxy, without touching your everyday browser or the Windows settings.
servizi.sotto: For each service you choose what to do: the choice applies to every connection. Only what the program can read can be protected.
rilevati.nota: Which AI tools are on this PC and which services it talks to. The label on the right shows the choice made in Rules for that service: it does not say the tool is protected right now. Only what goes through a connection is protected (you can see it in Activity).
rilevati.pc.sotto: Press Scan: it takes a few seconds and changes nothing.
rilevati.rete.niente: No contact with AI services detected.
rilevati.contattati: Services contacted through Omissis, last 30 days
rilevati.connessi: AI programs with open connections now
rilevati.dns: AI services recently resolved by this PC
rilevati.dns_vuoto: The Windows DNS cache is empty on this PC, so visited sites cannot be worked out from it. A full history comes from routing traffic through a connection, or from the firewall's DNS logs.
attivita.sotto: One row per request. Only counts and field names appear here, never the texts.

archivio.sotto: The mapping between placeholders and real values. It stays on this PC, encrypted with Windows data protection tied to your user, and is what makes restoring answers possible.
archivio.svuota.testo: Conversations and documents you already anonymised can no longer be turned back into the real values. This cannot be undone.
tipo.pagine_lette: pages read from the image (read them through)
